query: MATCH (s:PhysicalEntityRepresentation)-[:Modifier]->(p:Process) WHERE p.name STARTS WITH 'transcription' RETURN DISTINCT s.name
MATCH (s {name: 'LacI protein'})-[r:Reactant|Modifier]->(p:Process) RETURN p.name, type(r) UNION MATCH (p:Process)-[r:Product]->(s {name: 'LacI protein'}) RETURN p.name, type(r)
MATCH (s:PhysicalEntityRepresentation)-[:ContainedEntity]->(:PhysicalCompartment {id: 'cell'}) WHERE (s)-[:Reactant|Modifier]->(:Process) OR (:Process)-[:Product]->(s) RETURN DISTINCT s.name
MATCH (a {name: 'LacI protein'})--(p:Process)--(b {name: 'TetR mRNA'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.name
MATCH (s:PhysicalEntityRepresentation) WHERE NOT s:PhysicalCompartment WITH count(s) AS species MATCH (p:Process) RETURN species, count(p) AS reactions
MATCH (s:PhysicalEntityRepresentation)-[:Reactant|Product|Modifier]-(p:Process) RETURN s.name, count(DISTINCT p) AS reactions ORDER BY reactions DESC
